section.book: Bittinger, Beecher, Ellenbogen & Penna, College Algebra: Graphs and Models, 7e
section.title: Analyzing Graphs of Quadratic Functions

title: Range of a quadratic function that opens up
process_card: Finding the range of a quadratic function

steps.name: decide whether the parabola opens up or down
steps.show: a = {a}: opens up, so {k} is the minimum

steps.name: write the range in interval notation

mistakes.name: used a parenthesis at k
mistakes.message: The graph reaches k at the vertex, so k is in the range: use a square bracket.

mistakes.name: used the x-coordinate
mistakes.message: The range is y-values: use the y-coordinate of the vertex.

hints.why: The vertex holds the highest or lowest y-value.

hints.step: decide whether the parabola opens up or down
hints.hint: Look at the sign of a.
hints.why: Up: k is the smallest output. Down: k is the largest.

hints.step: write the range in interval notation
hints.why: Every y-value on the open side of k is reached, and k itself is reached.
